newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen flat ahead of election.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen flat ahead of election.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen flat in slow trading on Wednesday due to cautious sentiment ahead of the general elections on Thursday, brokers said.
"Some big-caps like Telkom may continue rebounding, but I suppose the market is likely to stay slow ahead of the election," one broker said.
Market heavyweight Telkom, which has staged a modest rebound in the past several days, had helped the index to remain firm despite the overall cautious sentiment, brokers said.
Brokers said the bargain-hunting in Telkom was likely to continue albeit in thin trading ahead of the announcement of its first quarter results on Friday.
Local buying of small-capitalised property stocks, including Mas Murni, was also likely to continue due to talk of rights issues and possible take-overs, brokers said.

Brokers said automobile conglomerates Astra and retailer Multipolar were likely to attract attention following announcements of rises in their first quarter net profits. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
Another big-cap Sampoerna, however, fell 75 rupiah to 9,350 rupiah despite announcing a rise in its first quarter net profit as the rise was considered to be below expectations, brokers said.

Small-capitalised property firm Mas Murni remained the most active, with some 24 million shares traded as profit-taking set in after sharp rises recently on speculation of a rights issue and a take-over.
Mas Murni fell 50 rupiah to 1,000 rupiah.
